o1: Enables catalase activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan; peroxisome organization; and response to oxidative stress. Is located in peroxisome. Used to study bacterial infectious disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in acatalasia; eye disease (multiple); lung disease (multiple); osteonecrosis; and pseudoxanthoma elasticum. Orthologous to human CAT (catalase).
